description: This file contains a self-invoking function that manages dynamic resizing of images in response to window size changes. It specifically targets elements with the class 'demo' to adjust their height based on the viewport width, ensuring responsive behavior.

methods.name: set_image_size()
methods.description: An immediately invoked function that defines and runs image resizing behavior based on window size.

methods.name: resize_images()
methods.description: Adjusts the height of images with class 'demo' depending on viewport width, stored original height, and sets up event handler for window resize.
